I've ported the Java server to Zig. `node check.mjs` passes all 4 cases (4/4), both on a normal run and after deleting all build output and rebuilding from scratch. `zig fmt` is clean and the unit tests pass. It uses only the Zig standard library (`std.http.Server` and the new `std.Io` networking), so `build.sh` has nothing to download.

Beyond the example cases, I ran it by hand against the edge cases in SPEC.md and all behaved correctly:
- **Values:** a random 1 MiB binary value comes back byt
